name: shortcut-forge
description: Apple Shortcuts MCP: build, lint and sign iOS Shortcuts (.shortcut) that actually run on iPhone.
long_description: Describe an automation in plain language. Claude designs it, shortcut-forge emits a real .shortcut plist that avoids known on-device failures (Stored Content, Health units, Reminders, If comparisons), lints it, and signs it with the macOS shortcuts CLI.

tools.name: shortcut_build
tools.description: Build a .shortcut from a JSON spec, lint it, optionally sign it

tools.name: shortcut_lint
tools.description: Check a shortcut for known on-device failure patterns

tools.name: shortcut_sign
tools.description: Sign with the macOS shortcuts CLI

tools.name: shortcut_reference
tools.description: Spec, pitfalls, lint rules, Health types, iOS 27 notes

tools.name: shortcut_library
tools.description: Browse 20+ community shortcuts to start from

tools.name: shortcut_submit
tools.description: Package your shortcut for the open-source library

tools.name: shortcut_publish
tools.description: Sign + manifest so installed copies can update
